annotations.title: Turn WhatsApp calling on or off

description:
Turn calling on or off for a Meta Cloud number. A customer calls this
number; it does not place calls. Turning it on requires every blocking
check to pass, or the request answers `409`. Turning it off is always
allowed.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

number_id.description:
Id of a WhatsApp number in your workspace, from
[listWhatsappNumbers](/docs/api-reference/whatsapp/listWhatsappNumbers).
A number in another workspace answers `404`.

enabled.description: `true` to turn calling on, `false` to turn it off.

name: setWhatsappCalling
